'''2000 Florida State Championship Gabriel Alonso FL States - Throne Room Mains ( No-Revo)''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Gabriel Alonso]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 2–1 at [[2000 Florida State Championship]]. The post (24 April 2000) says: 'This is the deck I used at states. It went 2-1 Losing to Raltiir Ops'; the title names FL States.<ref name="dt-5920">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5920 FL States - Throne Room Mains ( No-Revo)], DeckTech (Gabriel "The Diplomat" Alonso, 24 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5920/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5920/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018180516/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5920/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''FL States - Throne Room Mains ( No-Revo)'''
* '''Author:''' Gabriel "The Diplomat" Alonso
* '''Published:''' April 24, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' This is the deck I used at states. It went 2-1 Losing to Raltiir Ops, always a tough matchup.

=== Strategy ===

The primary focus of this deck is ground battles. It can get down mains and aliens down quickly to set up drains. The aliens are used to get around a possible Bad Feeling Have I start. Melas and Boshek can help get around Zuckuss in Mist Hunter or be used on the ground. The spies are useful versus Hunt Down, to drop a surprise hit squad, and late game to set up some drains at unprotected 2/0 locations.

My ISP is having problems. I keep losing connection. I will finish the rest of this in depth strategy section tommorrow pnce I get it resolved. Thanks for your patience.
